Ethereum delays its upgrade amid a sharp rise in costs

Ethereum will have to wait a few more weeks before receiving Glamsterdam. Developers have decided to postpone this upgrade until January 2027, probably toward the end of the month. The reason: an increase in the cost of creating smart contracts that could cause thousands of applications designed under the old rules to fail. Ethereum wants to increase capacity, but not at the cost of a network that only works partially.

The Ethereum Foundation and external researchers contacted more than 50 companies potentially affected by this change.

Deploying a 24-kilobyte contract could go from 4.95 million to 37.8 million gas, almost eight times more.

The four client teams, Geth, Nethermind, Reth, and ethrex, want to keep the new rules.

Ethereum wants to speed things up without blowing up its database

Glamsterdam should allow Ethereum to handle more operations simultaneously. The goal is especially to support the growth of onchain trading and lending services. However, this expansion comes at a cost: the amount of data nodes must retain is increasing rapidly.

In January 2026, the state database of a Geth node, which brings together the data needed for the network to function, weighed around 390 gibibytes. But since the gas limit rose from 30 million to 60 million, its daily growth has more than tripled, going from 105 to 326 mebibytes.

At a limit of 200 million gas, this database could grow by 387 gibibytes per year. In other words, nodes could have to store increasingly more data.

To limit this buildup, EIP-8037 introduces a fee of 1,530 gas units per byte of new state. This mechanism makes operations that add permanent data to the blockchain more expensive.

Ethereum retrasa su actualización ante una fuerte subida de costes

Ethereum tendrá que esperar unas semanas más antes de recibir Glamsterdam. Los desarrolladores han decidido posponer esta actualización hasta enero de 2027, probablemente hacia finales de mes. La causa: un aumento en el costo de creación de contratos inteligentes que podría hacer fallar miles de aplicaciones diseñadas según las reglas antiguas. Ethereum quiere ganar capacidad, pero no al precio de una red que funciona a medias.

La Fundación Ethereum y investigadores externos contactaron a más de 50 empresas potencialmente afectadas por este cambio.

El despliegue de un contrato de 24 kilobytes podría pasar de 4,95 a 37,8 millones de gas, casi ocho veces más.

Los cuatro equipos de clientes, Geth, Nethermind, Reth y ethrex, desean mantener las nuevas reglas.

Ethereum quiere acelerar sin hacer explotar su base de datos

Glamsterdam debe permitir que Ethereum gestione más operaciones simultáneamente. El objetivo es especialmente apoyar el crecimiento del trading onchain y los servicios de préstamo. Sin embargo, esta escalada tiene un costo: la cantidad de datos que los nodos deben conservar aumenta rápidamente.

En enero de 2026, la base de estado de un nodo Geth, que reúne los datos necesarios para el funcionamiento de la red, pesaba alrededor de 390 gibioctetos. Pero, desde que el límite de gas pasó de 30 a 60 millones, su crecimiento diario se ha más que triplicado, pasando de 105 a 326 mebioctetos.

A un límite de 200 millones de gas, esta base podría crecer 387 gibioctetos al año. En otras palabras, los nodos podrían tener que almacenar cada vez más datos.

Para limitar esta acumulación, la EIP-8037 introduce una tarifa de 1 530 unidades de gas por byte de nuevo estado. Este mecanismo encarece las operaciones que añaden datos permanentes a la blockchain.

translatedData.content:
A 7.18% drop by itself isn't much to talk about. What's worth talking about is that the cost of shorting into that drop has surged nearly 18-fold overnight. The ETH perpetual funding rate deteriorated from -0.0011% to -0.0194%/8h. Price is slowing down, but the cost of shorting is accelerating.

First, let's do the math. At -0.0194% every 8 hours, with three periods a day, that's about -21% annualized. In other words, anyone holding a short position right now has to pay fees at an annualized rate of 20% just to keep a position that's already down 7%. When short sellers have to pay an annualized 20% to hold on, it usually means positioning on that side has become expensive—not that the market is about to accelerate.

The second figure is even more telling: 74.1% of accounts are long, yet the funding rate is negative. Account counts and notional amounts are telling conflicting stories here. By headcount, 74% are long; by money, shorts are the ones weighing on price. Put another way, retail accounts are broadly trapped on one side, while the real size is on the other. Someone in a popular post asked, “Which position should I close? If I close the shorts, the longs will blow up.” Both sides are locked in and afraid to move—that's what the account structure looks like on the ground.

Third is the relationship between open interest and trading volume. Open interest is 3.824 billion USDT, while 24-hour volume is 15.096 billion, for turnover of nearly 4x. That ratio suggests most of today's trading is short-term positions changing hands back and forth, rather than new money coming in to build trend positions. High turnover paired with negative funding is a hallmark of a speculative, two-sided market—not a trending one.

There's another side effect that's easy to overlook: negative funding means trapped longs are getting paid. Even a position down 7% can still collect fees from shorts every 8 hours, which dilutes the urgency to cut losses. Longs who should have been flushed out have more reason to hang on thanks to that subsidy, while shorts who should be taking profits keep pressing on out of momentum. When neither side is willing to move, this kind of structure usually doesn't resolve through a slow grind lower; instead, a sharp move clears people out.

The narrative doesn't line up either. Standard Chartered's $4,000 target for ETH has a window of just over a month. The current price is 1,622.52, more than a double away, yet nobody in the perpetual market is willing to pay even a small premium to go long. Investment bank reports operate on a quarterly time scale; funding rates operate on an 8-hour time scale. Using the former to justify the latter is a mismatch of time horizons from the start.

So my leaning is this: the risk-reward for chasing shorts here is getting worse, but that doesn't mean the trend has reversed. A slowing decline combined with shorts paying more to stay in looks more like a signal of crowded positioning than confirmation of a trend. If you want to assess direction, wait for the rate to move back from -0.0194% toward zero before drawing conclusions. If you really want to short, you shouldn't add leverage while funding is negative—that's equivalent to subsidizing longs to hold their positions.

The risk is that once negative funding reaches an extreme, a short squeeze can arrive faster than expected. And often, price first sweeps lower before squeezing higher. Accounts locked in on both sides are the most likely to get hit from both directions in this kind of market.

#ETH #Crypto

content:
7.18%的跌幅本身没什么可说的，可说的是空头为这个跌幅付的钱一夜之间涨了快18倍。ETH永续资金费率从-0.0011%恶化到-0.0194%/8h，价格在减速，做空的成本却在加速。

先把这笔账算清楚。-0.0194%每8小时，一天三期，年化大约-21%。意思是现在拿着空单的人，要倒付年化两成的费用，只为维持一个已经跌了7%的仓位。做空做到要交两成年化才拿得住，通常说明这个方向上的仓位已经不便宜了，而不是行情要加速。

第二个数字比第一个更值得看：多头账户占比74.1%，费率却是负的。账户数和名义金额在这里是打架的。按人头数，七成四在做多；按钱算，压着价格的是空头。翻译过来就是散户账户大面积套在里面，而真正有体量的钱站在另一边。热帖里有人问“平哪个，平空多单会爆”，多空双向锁着不敢动，这就是账户结构的现场版。

第三个是持仓量和成交额的关系。持仓量38.24亿USDT，24小时成交150.96亿，换手接近4倍。这个比例说明今天大部分成交是短线仓位在里面来回倒手，而不是一批新钱进来建趋势仓。高换手配负费率，是博弈盘的特征，不是趋势盘的特征。

还有一个容易被忽略的副作用：费率转负意味着被套的多头在收钱。亏了7%的仓位，每8小时还能收到空头付的费，砍仓的紧迫感就被稀释了。本该出清的多头因为这笔补贴更有理由赖着不走，本该止盈的空头因为惯性继续压。两边都不肯动，这种结构最后一般不是靠慢慢阴跌来消化，而是一次快速波动把人清出去。

叙事端也对不上。渣打给ETH挂的4000目标价只有一多个月窗口，现价1622.52，中间隔着一倍多的距离，但永续盘口没人愿意为多单付哪怕一点溢价。投行报告是季度尺度的东西，资金费率是8小时尺度的东西，拿前者给后者找依据，时间尺度先错位了。

所以我偏向的判断是：这个位置追空的赔率在变差，但不是方向变了。跌势减速叠加空头加价续持，更像拥挤度提示，不像趋势确认。想看方向，等费率从-0.0194%回到零附近再谈；真想空，也不该在负费率里加杠杆，那等于替多头付持仓补贴。

风险在于负费率极端化之后的空头挤压往往来得比预期快，而且经常先往下扫一遍再往上挤，双向锁仓的账户在这种行情里最容易两头挨打。

今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Afford Losses to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s run the numbers】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
The account is only down 20%, so a few winning trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You'd need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you're almost as good as finished.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%”; it’s “the amount you lose if this trade hits your stop-loss
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work out the position size.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scale Out to Take Profits: How to Lock in Gains While Letting Profits Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out profit-taking strategy I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage 1: When price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), close 1/3 of your position to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage 2: When price reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), close another 1/3. Stage 3: Let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you exit the whole position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you often end up right back where you started.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Place it too close and it gets triggered every day; too far away and one loss can wipe you out.

to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other traders’ stop-losses.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if the price breaks through this level, it means evidence has emerged that I was wrong.

往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, let’s talk about how to use them as a sentiment thermometer.

【State 1: Persistently high positive funding rates】This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. That doesn’t mean you should immediately
Not that you should short—instead, be especially cautious about going long at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

【State 2: Persistently negative funding rates】Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to get out has already left, and people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past got their start at times like these.

VanEck adjusts ETHV custody | ETH around $1,621 | Don’t mistake a service-provider change for selling

My stance is defensive, but this institutional news needs to be separated into facts before discussing the direction of the market. An 8-K filed with the U.S. SEC on November 19 shows that the sponsor of the VanEck Ethereum ETF (ETHV) notified Gemini on November 16 of its intention to terminate the existing ETH custody agreement and digital asset trading and clearing agreement. The filing states that the termination is expected to take effect around February 16, 2027. Until then, Gemini will continue providing services, and Coinbase Custody will continue to serve as the fund’s ETH custodian. In other words, notice has been given, but the contracts have not been terminated immediately, and the fund has not announced a liquidation or sale of its ETH holdings in this filing.

The main ways this could affect the crypto market are through institutional operations and counterparty management. An ETF needs to connect asset custody, fiat accounts, trading settlement, and share creation and redemption. Changing one of these service relationships could alter future execution procedures and concentration, but it does not automatically mean that an equivalent amount of ETH will suddenly be sold on-chain. The 8-K does not give a reason for the termination, nor does it say that Gemini has had a new security incident, so I won’t invent a motive on the filing’s behalf. We need to verify any actual asset transfers, operational arrangements, and risk disclosures going forward; we shouldn’t see “custody termination” and immediately assume ETH will be sold off.

Another set of facts about institutional flows comes from Farside’s U.S. ETH fund data for November 19: total net outflows were about $131.2 million, with ETHA seeing outflows of about $124.2 million and ETHV showing zero for the day. The November 20 row is still blank, so the page’s temporary total of zero should not be treated as the full-day result. We need to distinguish between two things: ETHV’s service-provider arrangements are an operational change for the fund, while fund net subscriptions and redemptions reflect changes in investor demand. Even if they occur on the same day, that does not establish that the former caused the latter. Current trending topics on Binance Square are focused on BTC falling below $60,000 and weakness in global equities. Although ETH is listed under Most Searched, I can’t confirm any rising tag directly related to this announcement, so I won’t force a connection to topics about other coins.

How has the market reacted so far? When I checked Binance ETH/USDT spot, ETH was around $1,621, with a 24-hour low of $1,581 and a high of $1,771, and was still down about 7%. A rebound from the low doesn’t mean institutional flows have turned positive, and the decline can’t be attributed to one ETHV filing. My previous ETH post focused on $1,580, $1,650, and $1,700. This round’s low did not break below $1,580, but I have no confirmed trades to report, so I can only say the defensive level has temporarily withstood one test. Next, I’ll first watch to see whether ETH can reclaim $1,650; $1,700 would be stronger confirmation. If it falls below $1,580 and then rebounds weakly, the current stabilization view is invalidated. Only if it closes above $1,700 consistently on the four-hour chart and fund net outflows subsequently ease will I consider increasing my risk budget.

If I were trading it myself: I would stay out for now. The only direction I’d consider is a small spot ETH long, capped at 2% of total capital, with no leverage. The entry trigger would be a four-hour close above $1,650, followed by a retest that holds between $1,635 and $1,650. If ETH first falls below $1,580, I’ll cancel the plan. The first target is $1,700, where I’d sell half; the target for the remainder is $1,770, with a phased exit as it approaches the previous high. The initial stop-loss would be below $1,575. After entry, I’d exit the entire position early if ETH closes below $1,635 again on the four-hour chart, or if subsequent complete fund data continues to deteriorate significantly. If the conditions aren’t met, I’ll remain in cash and wait; I won’t treat the announcement itself as a trading signal.

#ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

VanEck调整ETHV托管｜ETH约1621美元｜别把换服务商当抛售

我的态度偏防守，但这条机构消息需要先拆清楚事实，再谈方向。11月19日递交美国SEC的8-K显示，VanEck Ethereum ETF（ETHV）的发起人已在11月16日通知Gemini，拟终止原有的ETH托管协议和数字资产交易清算协议。文件写明，终止预计在2027年2月16日前后生效；在此之前Gemini仍继续提供服务，Coinbase Custody也将继续担任该基金的ETH托管方。也就是说，通知已经发出，合同尚未立刻终止，基金也没有在这份文件中宣布清盘或卖出所持ETH。

这件事影响加密市场的路径主要是机构运营和对手方管理。ETF需要把资产保管、法币账户、买卖结算和份额创建赎回接起来；更换其中一条服务关系，可能改变后续执行流程与集中度，却不能自动推出链上突然出现一笔等额卖盘。8-K没有给出终止原因，更没有说Gemini发生新的安全事故，所以我不会替文件补上动机。后续要核实实际资产转移、运营安排和风险披露，不能看到“终止托管”就猜ETH会被抛售。

机构资金面的另一组事实是Farside的11月19日美国ETH基金数据：全体净流出约1.312亿美元，ETHA约流出1.242亿美元，ETHV当日显示零。11月20日一行仍为空白，页面临时总计零不能当作全天结果。这里要分清两类东西：ETHV服务商安排是基金运营变化，基金净申赎是投资者需求变化；即使同一天出现，也不能据此认定前者导致了后者。广场当前热题集中在BTC跌破6万美元及全球股市疲弱，ETH虽列入Most Searched，却没有我能确认且与此公告直接对应的上升标签，因此不硬蹭其他币种的话题。

市场已如何反应？我查看币安ETH/USDT现货时约1621美元，24小时低点1581、高点1771，仍跌约7%。从低点回升不代表机构资金已经翻正，也不能把跌幅归因于ETHV的一份文件。上一条ETH帖关注1580、1650、1700；本轮低点没有跌破1580，但我没有任何已成交记录，只能说防守线暂时经受一次测试。接下来先看1650能否站回，1700是更强确认；若跌破1580后反抽无力，当前的企稳判断失效。若四小时连续收上1700且后续基金净流出收敛，才考虑提高风险预算。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与，方向仅考虑ETH现货试多，仓位上限为总资金的2%，不用杠杆。入场触发是四小时收在1650上方，随后回踩1635至1650不破；若先跌破1580，取消计划。首目标1700，到位减半；余仓目标1770，接近前高分批平仓。初始止损放在1575下方；入场后若四小时重新收在1635以下，或基金后续完整数据继续显著恶化，提前全部平仓。条件未满足就空仓等待，不把公告当成交易信号本身。

Nvidia’s quarterly revenue surged to $115.8 billion, far above market expectations, and its stock jumped after the close. This directly sent the semiconductor sector soaring, but Bitcoin and Ethereum don’t seem to have followed much—in fact, they fell again. For cryptocurrencies, is this round of Nvidia growth actually bullish, or just irrelevant?

Why is this news important?
Nvidia’s results are not just an ordinary earnings report; it is the undisputed leader in the new AI computing race. The sharp rise in revenue this time reflects an explosion in AI demand, which directly ignited the engine behind tech stocks. What does that mean for cryptocurrencies? Simple: if AI needs large amounts of cryptocurrency mining, then mining competition becomes intense and computing costs may surge. But then again, Nvidia uses TSMC’s chips, so it has little direct connection to Bitcoin miners.

Impact on the market
The impact on BTC and ETH is more like scratching an itch through a shoe. On one hand, a tech stock rally may boost broader market sentiment, which in theory is supportive for cryptocurrencies. On the other hand, companies at Nvidia’s scale are more likely to pay in U.S. dollars or stablecoins, and cryptocurrency’s share of payments may still be tiny. Moreover, if AI demand is really this strong, traditional computing centers may become more favored, and Bitcoin’s computing power advantage could instead become a burden. Just two days ago, we said CME futures were raking in trading volume—are institutions really entering the market? Looking at it now, institutions may be paying more attention to the new AI story than to the old Bitcoin story.

Trading idea
The market may have already digested the direct bullish effect of Nvidia’s growth on cryptocurrencies. To be honest, in the short term, Bitcoin and Ethereum will still depend more on their own fundamentals and macro sentiment. If Nvidia’s AI demand can really translate into cryptocurrency mining demand, we may not see a clear effect until next year. Nvidia的季度收入暴增到1158亿美元，比市场预期多得多，收盘后股价连夜涨。这事儿直接把半导体板块给带飞了，但比特币和以太坊好像没怎么跟着嗨，反而又跌了。对加密货币来说，Nvidia这波增长到底是利好还是白给？

为什么这条新闻重要？
Nvidia的业绩不是普通公司财报，它是AI算力这个新赛道的绝对龙头。这次收入暴涨背后是AI需求井喷，这直接点燃了科技股的引擎。对加密货币来说，意味着什么？很简单：如果AI要用大量加密货币挖矿，那挖矿的竞争就白热化了，算力成本可能要飙升。但话说回来，Nvidia用的是台积电的芯片，跟比特币矿工没啥直接关系。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH的影响更像是隔靴搔痒。一方面，科技股大涨可能会带动大盘情绪，理论上对加密货币有提振作用。但另一方面，Nvidia这种级别的企业更倾向于用美元或稳定币支付，加密货币的支付份额可能还小得可怜。而且，如果AI需求真的这么强劲，那传统计算中心可能更受青睐，比特币的算力优势反而成了负担。前两天刚说过CME期货在狂揽交易量，机构入场是真是假？现在看来，机构可能更关注AI赛道里的新故事，而不是比特币这种老故事。

操作思路
Nvidia这波增长对加密货币的直接利好可能被市场消化了。说实话，短期内比特币和以太坊的走势更多还是看自己的基本面和宏观情绪。如果Nvidia的AI需求真的能转化为加密货币挖矿需求，那可能要等到明年才能看到明显效果。如果地缘政治或美联储突然变脸，这个逻辑就作废了。

Market Overview | Low-volume consolidation near the lows; ZEC sets a new low with a long lower wick

After the breakdown in the early hours, the broader market didn’t continue to plunge, but there was no meaningful rebound either. BTC and ETH hovered near their lows for two hours as trading volume fell to its lowest level of the day. The most notable signal came from ZEC: it set a new 24-hour low of $726.49, but closed with a very long lower wick.

Looking at the broader trend, the initial wave of selling after the breakdown has largely run out of steam: BTC’s 1-hour trading volume fell from 3,551 coins to 1,138, and ETH’s volume also declined. Open interest shrank in tandem, suggesting few traders are still chasing shorts at these levels. But there’s also no follow-through on the rebound. The long/short ratio remains elevated at 3.43, and dip-buying positions are crowded. The real risk is that if 57,778 is breached again, these longs could become a fresh source of selling pressure. With no new macro catalysts after the U.S. market close, the market will likely continue to grind sideways near the lows overnight. Watching key levels is more important than guessing the direction.

$BTC

Currently trading at $58,905, down 4.35% over 24 hours.

• Support: $58,200
• Resistance: $58,917

The 05:00 hourly candle had a low of 58,200 and a high of 58,917, closing at 58,860. Volume was just 1,138 coins, the lowest of the past six hourly candles. The price held around 58,200, but the rebound couldn’t even hold above 58,917, suggesting that while selling pressure has dried up, buyers haven’t stepped in either. The funding rate has turned slightly negative at -0.004%. Open interest fell from 97,225 to 95,999 coins over six hours, indicating that leverage is gradually leaving the market. A move back above 60,025 would be needed to talk about a sustained rebound. If 58,200 breaks, followed by the 24-hour low of 57,778, only the psychological support of round-number levels remains below.

$ETH

Currently trading at $1,621, down 6.94% over 24 hours.

• Support: $1,581
• Resistance: $1,644

ETH remains relatively weaker than BTC, with its 24-hour loss nearly 1.6 times BTC’s. The 05:00 hourly candle found support at 1,594.84 and recovered to close above 1,620, but volume was only 26,484 coins—far below the 222,966 coins traded during the 4-hour candle when the breakdown occurred. The funding rate is negative at -0.019%, meaning shorts are paying. Open interest fell from 2.41 million coins to 2.36 million, with both longs and shorts reducing their positions. ETH first needs to reclaim 1,644 to shake off its weakness. A break below 1,581 would bring another test of the lows, and there are still no signs that the short-term strength gap between BTC and ETH is narrowing.

$ZEC

Currently trading at $749, down 15.22% over 24 hours.

• Support: $726
• Resistance: $793

ZEC was the strongest coin to suffer a catch-up decline today. The 04:00 hourly candle first tested 731.5, then the 05:00 candle tested 726.49 to set a new 24-hour low, before recovering to 749.8 and closing with a long lower wick. Open interest, however, briefly rose from 487,000 to 508,000 coins near the new low, suggesting that some traders opened new positions there. The long/short ratio is 0.82, indicating that short accounts are in the majority, while the funding rate is close to neutral at +0.005%. The long lower wick combined with rising open interest suggests a possible short-term attempt to find a bottom. But with 24-hour trading volume at $237 million and a 15% decline, a lower wick at this level looks more like short covering than a trend reversal. Until it gets back above 793, treat this as an oversold bounce.

My take:

The current bias is neutral to slightly bearish. The initial wave of selling after the breakdown has lost momentum: falling volume, shrinking open interest, and negative funding rates all point to shorts easing off. But bulls are just as reluctant to enter, and BTC’s long/short ratio of 3.43 means dip-buying positions are already crowded. The key levels are BTC at 58,200/57,778 and ETH at 1,581. If these levels hold, the market may continue consolidating near the lows; a rebound becomes more plausible if volume picks up. But a high-volume breakdown would amplify losses as crowded longs hit their stops. In terms of positioning, I wouldn’t chase shorts or rush to buy the dip. I’d wait for BTC to reclaim 60,025, or for a high-volume break below 57,778, before confirming direction.

市场盘面｜低位缩量磨底，ZEC 新低长下影

凌晨这波破位之后，大盘没有继续往下砸，但也没有像样的反弹，BTC 和 ETH 贴着低点磨了两个小时，成交量缩到了今天最低。最值得看的信号在 ZEC 身上：它又创了 24 小时新低 726.49 美元，但收出了一根很长的下影线。

从大势上看，破位第一波的杀跌动能基本耗尽了：BTC 1 小时成交量从 3551 枚一路缩到 1138 枚，ETH 的量也在递减，持仓量同步缩水，说明这个位置追空的人不多了。但反弹同样没人接力，多空比还挂在 3.43 的高位，抄底盘很拥挤，真正的风险在于——如果 57778 再被打穿，这些多头会变成新的抛压。美股收盘后没有新的宏观消息刺激，夜里大概率还是低位磨盘的节奏，盯位置比猜方向更重要。

$BTC

现报 58905 美元，24 小时下跌 4.35%。

• 支撑：58200 美元
• 压力：58917 美元

05 点这根小时线低点 58200、高点 58917，收在 58860，量只有 1138 枚，是最近六根小时线里最少的一根。价格守住了 58200 一带，但反弹连 58917 都没站稳，说明卖盘枯竭的同时买盘也没进场。资金费率 -0.004% 略微转负，持仓量六小时从 97225 枚缩到 95999 枚，杠杆在慢慢离场。站回 60025 才能谈反弹延续，跌破 58200、再破 57778 的 24 小时低点，下方就只剩整数关口的心理支撑了。

$ETH

现报 1621 美元，24 小时下跌 6.94%。

• 支撑：1581 美元
• 压力：1644 美元

ETH 相对 BTC 依然偏弱，24 小时跌幅几乎是 BTC 的 1.6 倍。05 点小时线在 1594.84 止跌收回 1620 上方，但量能只有 26484 枚，远低于破位那根 4 小时线的 222966 枚。资金费率 -0.019% 为负，空头在付费；持仓量从 241 万枚缩到 236 万枚，多空都在减仓。ETH 要先站回 1644 才能摆脱弱势，跌破 1581 则会再探新低，BTC/ETH 的强弱差短期内还看不到收敛的迹象。

$ZEC

现报 749 美元，24 小时下跌 15.22%。

• 支撑：726 美元
• 压力：793 美元

ZEC 是今天补跌最狠的强势币，04 点小时线先探 731.5，05 点再探 726.49 创 24 小时新低，随后收回 749.8，收出一根长下影线。持仓量却在新低附近一度从 48.7 万枚加到 50.8 万枚，说明有人在低点开新仓，多空比 0.82 空头账户占优，资金费率 +0.005% 接近中性。长下影线加持仓量放大，短线有止跌试探的意思，但 24 小时成交额 2.37 亿美元、跌幅 15%，这种位置的下影线更像是空头回补而不是趋势反转，站不回 793 之前先当超跌反抽看。

我的观察：

当前偏中性略偏空：破位后的第一波杀跌动能衰竭了，量缩、持仓缩水、费率转负都指向空头在收手，但多头同样没有进场意愿，BTC 多空比 3.43 意味着抄底盘已经很拥挤。关键分水岭在 BTC 的 58200/57778 和 ETH 的 1581，守住这里低位磨盘、等量能回暖才有反弹可谈；一旦放量跌破，拥挤的多头止损会把跌幅放大。仓位上不追空也不急着抄底，等 BTC 站回 60025、或者放量跌破 57778 之后再确认方向。

ZEC 这根 726 美元的长下影线，你们觉得是空头回补的短线止跌，还是跌势中继的喘息？

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
that they make to each other. The exchange only collects and distributes the payments; it doesn’t make money from them.

【How it works】Perpetual contracts have no settlement date, so how does their price stay in line with the spot price? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is above the spot price (strong bullish sentiment) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is below the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
The money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to take action.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, at 10x leverage, that’s 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat through the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of the position first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.
